svg.text: Raspberry Pi 4 · 8 GB · Multi-channel L1 Agent · Telegram-controlled · TOTP-gated · audit-logged
🖥 Raspberry Pi 4 — 8 GB · systemd user services (linger enabled)
Python Telegram bot · shell / git / npm executor
All shell / git / npm execution runs through mgmt-bot
Out-of-band control even if the gateway is down
openclaw-gateway.service (Fastify ws + http · systemd user unit)
Vector embeddings · hybrid BM25 + vector · LanceDB / SQLite store
web_search · web_fetch · browser · canvas — NOT in coding profile
install-forked-openclaw.sh — single source of truth (pull → build → config → restart)
systemd user units: gateway · email-microsoft · email-gmail · pollers
Sync: Workspace ──Git pane──▶ GitHub ──git pull──▶ Pi
reverse: Pi ──push──▶ GitHub ──Pull──▶ Workspace (workspace CLI push blocked)
fed by L2 · tidied by L1 (shared store below) · Files.ReadWrite + Sites.ReadWrite.All
calendar writes go ONLY through MS integration (calendar.* denied)
switches primary ↔ Codex via systemd user-session env (DBUS)
Codex OAuth must be fresh, else falls back to OpenAI gpt-5.4
Codex OAuth refresh nightly → fallback to gpt-5.4
Plugin manifest needs id — bad stub aborts all channels
"active" service ≠ assistant working — always send a test msg
config chattr +i · audit chattr +a · totp secret chattr +i
denylist evaluated BEFORE TOTP — even an open window cannot bypass
writes .md + files into the SharePoint folder
runs outside the Pi · its own agent / LLM
L2 fills it ▸ L1 tidies it · gateway mirrors this store
